pattern: Probe start without the stripped template
symptom: The game hangs on the loading screen with the probe as main.scm
check: Diff the probe's startup against data\vc_sbl\stripped.txt
fix: Add declare_mission_flag, the dress calls, Streaming.SetAreaVisible, and SetControl

symptom: Txd.LoadDictionary freezes the game, and the ini stops before the next step
check: The name is in double quotes
fix: Use single quotes, at most 7 characters

symptom: The last key row sits off the bottom edge by about one row
"An incorrect version of CLEO was loaded" and every 0B40 logs an incorrect opcode
check: cleo.log says Failed to load plugin cell-phone.cleo

symptom: Unable to load X.asi, a dependency is missing
fix: Find the import DLL that is not in the game folder, then check what it needs

pattern: Game text for the LCD digits
symptom: The number wraps onto a second line after five digits
check: Order of SetCenter and SetWrapX does not change it
fix: Draw the digits as glyph sprites

symptom: The game dies about 4 s after launch, before cleo.log writes
check: EasyFont.VC.asi and rwd3d9.dll are in the game folder
fix: Keep EasyFont out; it sits in .easyfont-backup in the game folder

symptom: A manual import-skin over dist/phone/*.png packs textures an earlier render left behind
check: dist/phone holds more PNGs than sizes.csv has rows
fix: Run deno task render-phone, which packs only its own list

symptom: The pack step of render-phone never runs, and the TXD is stale
check: The output was piped to Select-Object -First N
fix: Pipe to Select-Object -Last N, or do not pipe

pattern: Stale plugin in the game folder
symptom: The phone works but a new tone or behavior is missing, with no error
check: Compare the SHA-256 of <VC>\CLEO\cell-phone.cleo with plugins/cell-phone/build/Release/cell-phone.cleo; deno task probe never installs the plugin
fix: Run deno task build, then deno task install

pattern: Plugin timing constant out of sync with the script
symptom: The ringback starts before the HUD swaps the number for the timer, or the call drops mid-tone
check: kRingbackDelayMs in tones.h differs from timerb < 500 in cellphone.txt, or kBusyToneMs no longer equals the kBusy cadence
fix: Change the pair together; kBusyToneMs derives from kBusy through ToneDurationMs

pattern: Pressed look on a scripted key
symptom: The on-screen key does not sink for a key the probe injected
fix: Press the real key to check the look

symptom: The taxi reaches the player, then drives away and despawns
check: MarkAsNoLongerNeeded runs in the same step as CarMission.StopForever
fix: Keep the car owned while it waits, and release it only when it should leave

symptom: A tone is silent while the game plays sound
check: ReadSfxVolume returns 0 for the byte at 0x869659, or waveOutOpen fails
fix: The slider byte is unverified outside gta-vc.exe v1.0; a read outside 0 to 127 falls back to 102
